claim_framing: Fuzzy repair-priority scoring did not beat no-repair and/or the simpler competitors (Gate 4 FAIL) - negative evidence, not fabricated into a claim. The 'Fuzzy' in the project name is historical identity only and must NOT be read as a validated claim: the fuzzy scorer remains in the codebase as an optional, NON-DEFAULT scorer. The codec (capture, Unicode grouping, fragility estimation, quantization, pruning, allocation, metadata coding, decoder) is unaffected and preserved; its surviving, evidence-grounded contribution is tokenizer-fragmentation-aware KV compression.
